component.name: OSCLeash
component.summary: VRChat OSC tool to move a player in the direction of a stretched Physbone.

description.p: A VRChat OSC tool to move a player in the direction of a stretched Physbone. For leashes, tails, or even hand holding!

ul.li: Converted Constraints to VRC Constraints & added info on cross-platform support by @korbykob in #30
Add OSCQuery support (for parameter receiving from VRChat) by @cyberkitsune in #27
